name: binders-runner
description: Runs an agent for each card Binders gives it: stays connected to the hub, and starts Claude Code, Codex or your own command headless in your workspace.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/binders-runner.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
